en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a densely built city with tiled-roof houses and at least one prominent mosque with a tall minaret in the middle ground. Hills and more buildings appear in the background. The printed caption under the image reads "83. SALONIQUE" followed by multilingual text "Un Panorama — A Panorama". At the bottom left is the editor credit "Edit. Koller, Lyon".
